evidence: XPS results show that after six exposure cycles of TMAA and NH3 at 300 K, no peaks in the binding-energy range 396.4-396.8 eV, assignable to AlN, were detected. The process that was most successful at producing crystalline AlN involved deposition at 300 K followed by high-temperature annealing at 1200 K, suggesting that the critical parameter may be the introduction of sufficient additional energy [thermal or otherwise) between exposure cycles to promote crystallization.
